title: cereus oxygonus
intro: Cereus oxygonus, commonly known as the dragon fruit cactus, is a type of cactus species that belongs to the family Cactaceae. This plant is known for its unique ability to produce vibrant pink or yellow flowers, followed by edible fruit. The health benefits of Cereus oxygonus include its potential to support immune function and reduce inflammation, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
